verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no SaaS region or residency selection, but Sentry can be fully self-hosted on your own server, so you control where data lives. That route has real caveats: Sentry says the self-hosted setup comes with no guarantees or dedicated support, and users report heavy resource and maintenance burden, which the founder acknowledges. Missing for 10: documented SaaS data-region selection (e.g. US/EU), residency or compliance guarantees, and a supported way to choose residency without self-hosting.
